method: Same Chromium process, separate contexts, sequential rendering (the other page has no animation loop). Fixed poses, seed4201, simulation clock120, profileBALANCED Q1, camera58deg, actual1152x648 drawing buffer. Complete streaming convergence before captures. The local shadow system keeps its existing four-Hz update schedule during timed rendering. AB/BA alternation across repeated paired measurements. Timings exclude shader/resource instrumentation; a separate untimed diagnostic pass records those counters. Physics paused: these are rendering observations, not control or real-time-flight evidence.
limits: SwiftShader software renderer, NOT Mali-G72 or Galaxy A51.
Three repeated runs give descriptive paired variability, not a reliable hardware-performance confidence interval.
CPU submission includes browser/driver overhead; GPU timings are reported only when nonblocking extension results are valid.
Texture residency is an estimate from dimensions and mip flags; not a driver memory measurement.
Long tasks are observable main-thread stalls, not identified garbage collections.
Input latency, Android PSS, thermals, battery and physical-device acceptance remain unavailable.

productionLoopObservations.method: Separate 30-wall-second instrumented observations execute the saved production loop on native RAF timestamps. Both start parked on the same runway with throttle0 and parking brake. The loop variable remains a no-op so its internal RAF scheduling does not start a second loop. Function spans are inclusive and must not be added together. Physics, weather, UI, terrain and normal governor all run. The timing correction changes simulated progression, scenery clocks and potentially work/trajectory, so these observations are NOT a controlled FPS speedup comparison.

before.instrumentation: Function wrappers and optional bounded v0.5 diagnostics enabled. No overhead-corrected performance claim.
